about_the_game:
Once again, these pathetic humans have survived the apocalypse. But not this time.
You are the dark mind behind history’s greatest monster invasions, and now it’s time to finish what you started. Take control of your minions, turn the tide, and wipe humanity off the map. They think they can fight back? Show them what a real threat looks like!

Features

  • Possess your minions and control them directly to slaughter as many humans as possible.

  • Three unique environments, each filled with deadly traps and relentless enemies.

  • Upgrades and synergies to customize your playstyle.

  • Crush humanity’s greatest heroes and make an example of them.

Massacre hordes of humans

Do these weak creatures really think they can rule for much longer? Harness the power of your possessed monsters, unlock devastating abilities, and make sure not a single human escapes alive.

Build your ultimate legion

Every run gives you the chance to experiment with unique upgrades. Acquire powerful singularities, unlock new passives, and fine-tune your strategy to turn your creatures into unstoppable killing machines. Every choice can mean the difference between total domination… or another attempt.

Face their so-called "heroes"

Humanity won’t go down without a fight—they’re sending their strongest warriors to stop you. Elite soldiers, valkyries, and legendary fighters will stand in your way. It’s up to you to crush their last hope for survival.

List of Features Available in the Demo

  • Playable Faction: Zombies

  • Singularities: 15

  • Passives: 20

  • Human Units: 5

  • Bosses: 4

  • Random Challenges: 4

All the features described on the demo page are fully playable in this version. However, the demo does not include meta progression or the difficulty modulator, which will be available in the Early Access release.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 / AMD RX 570
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 3.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 / AMD RX 570

short_description: What's more frustrating than watching an army of monsters fail to wipe out humanity? Take control of a minion and turn the tide in a roguelite survival game. Just died? No problem—another creature is ready to be possessed. Keep the carnage going and make sure humanity meets its end!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
